meals.name: Korean-style sweet-and-spicy ground turkey rice bowls with quick-pickled cucumbers
steps: Start 1½ cups rice. Thinly slice 1 cucumber and toss with ¼ cup vinegar, 1 tsp sugar and ½ tsp salt; set aside to quick-pickle.
Whisk the sauce: ¼ cup soy sauce, 2 Tbsp brown sugar, 1–2 Tbsp sriracha, 1 Tbsp sesame oil, 4 minced garlic cloves and 1 tsp ground ginger.
Heat 1 Tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Cook 1 diced onion 3 minutes, then add 2 lb ground turkey and cook, breaking it up, until browned and 165°F, 8–10 minutes.
Pour in the sauce and simmer 2–3 minutes until glossy and mostly absorbed. Spoon over rice with the pickled cucumbers and sliced green onions.

meals.name: Chili-lime chicken fajitas with charred peppers and avocado
steps: Slice 2 lb chicken breast into strips. Toss with 2 Tbsp oil, juice of 1 lime, 2 tsp chili powder, 1 tsp cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, ½ tsp oregano, 1 tsp brown sugar and 1 tsp salt; marinate 15 minutes.
Heat a large skillet over high. Sear the chicken in two batches, 5–6 minutes each, until charred and 165°F; move to a plate.
Add 2 sliced red peppers and 1 sliced onion with a pinch of salt; cook 5–6 minutes until charred at the edges. Return the chicken and squeeze in the second lime.
Warm 10 flour tortillas in a dry pan. Fill with chicken and peppers, sliced avocado (2) and sour cream.

meals.name: Garlic-herb roast pork loin with honey-balsamic pan sauce and crispy creamer potatoes
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Rub a 3 lb piece of pork loin with 1 Tbsp olive oil, 4 minced garlic cloves, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp smoked paprika, 2 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper.
Halve 3 lb creamer potatoes and cut 1 onion into wedges; toss with 2 Tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper and spread around the pork on a sheet pan.
Roast 45–55 minutes, until the pork is 145°F and the potatoes are crisp. Rest the pork 10 minutes.
Meanwhile simmer ½ cup broth, 2 Tbsp balsamic, 1 Tbsp honey and 1 tsp Dijon 4 minutes until syrupy; whisk in 1 Tbsp butter and any pan juices. Slice the pork and spoon the sauce over.

meals.name: Honey-hot glazed chicken legs with brown-sugar roasted butternut squash
steps: Heat oven to 425°F. Pat 4 lb bone-in drumsticks or thighs dry and season with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp salt and ½ tsp pepper. Arrange on a rack or sheet pan.
Peel and cube a 2½ lb butternut squash; toss with 1 Tbsp oil, 1 Tbsp brown sugar, ¼ tsp cinnamon and a pinch of salt on a second pan.
Roast both 35–45 minutes, until the squash is caramelized and the chicken is 165°F (175°F is even more tender for dark meat).
Melt 3 Tbsp butter with ¼ cup honey, 2–3 Tbsp hot sauce and 2 minced garlic cloves. Brush over the chicken and return to the oven 5 minutes to set the glaze.

meals.name: Creamy Cajun shrimp and sausage pasta
steps: Mix the Cajun spice: 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder and thyme, ½ tsp oregano, ¼–½ tsp cayenne, 1 tsp salt. Peel 1 lb shrimp and toss with half the spice. Cook 1 lb pasta in salted water; save 1 cup pasta water.
In a large skillet over medium-high, brown 1 lb ground sausage until no pink remains and 160°F, 6–8 minutes; scoop out, leaving the drippings.
Add 1 Tbsp olive oil and the shrimp; cook 1–2 minutes per side until pink and 145°F, then set aside with the sausage.

Sauté 1 diced onion and 3 minced garlic cloves 3 minutes. Add 1 can diced tomatoes, the rest of the spice and 1 cup heavy cream; simmer 4 minutes. Stir in ½ cup Parmesan, the pasta, sausage and shrimp, loosening with pasta water. Top with green onions.

meals.name: Smoky vine-tomato and white bean shakshuka with garlic toast (meatless)
steps: Heat 2 Tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium. Cook 1 diced onion 5 minutes, then add 4 minced garlic cloves, 1½ tsp cumin, 1½ tsp smoked paprika, ½ tsp red pepper flakes and 1 Tbsp tomato paste for 1 minute.
Add 2½ lb chopped vine tomatoes, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp honey; simmer 12–15 minutes until saucy. Stir in 1 drained can of white beans.
Make 8 wells and crack in 8 eggs. Cover and cook on low 6–8 minutes, until the whites are set.
Slice the Italian bread, brush with 1 Tbsp olive oil, rub with a cut garlic clove and toast. Sprinkle the shakshuka with herbs and serve with the toast.

meals.name: Smoky beef and bean chili with cheddar and sour cream
steps: In a large pot over medium-high, brown 2 lb ground beef with 1 diced onion until no pink remains and the beef is 160°F, 8–10 minutes; drain extra fat.
Stir in 4 minced garlic cloves, 3 Tbsp chili powder, 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp oregano; toast 1 minute.
Add a 28 oz can crushed tomatoes, 2 drained cans of beans, 1 cup broth, 1 Tbsp brown sugar and 1½ tsp salt. Simmer uncovered 30 minutes, stirring now and then.
Finish with 1 Tbsp cider vinegar and hot sauce to taste. Serve topped with shredded cheddar (8 oz block) and sour cream.

meals.name: Honey-Dijon pork chops with garlic green beans and rice
steps: Start 1 cup rice. Season 2 lb boneless pork chops with 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp pepper and 1 tsp thyme.
Heat 1 Tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium-high. Sear the chops 4–5 minutes per side until 145°F; rest on a plate.

Lower the heat to medium. Add 1 Tbsp butter and 3 minced garlic cloves, then whisk in ½ cup broth, 3 Tbsp mustard, 2 Tbsp honey and 1 tsp cider vinegar. Simmer 3 minutes until slightly thick; return the chops and any juices and spoon the sauce over.
Meanwhile sauté 1 lb trimmed green beans in 1 Tbsp butter with 2 minced garlic cloves and a pinch of salt, 6–7 minutes. Serve everything with the rice.

meals.name: Spanish chorizo and chickpea stew with spinach and crusty bread
steps: Slice 4 oz chorizo into thin coins. Warm 2 Tbsp olive oil in a pot over medium and cook the chorizo 3 minutes until it releases its red oil.
Add 1 diced onion and cook 5 minutes; stir in 4 minced garlic cloves, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp cumin for 1 minute.
Add 2 drained cans chickpeas, 1 can diced tomatoes and 1½ cups broth. Simmer 15 minutes, lightly mashing some chickpeas to thicken.
Stir in 5 oz spinach until wilted, then 1 tsp vinegar and salt to taste. Serve with warm sliced baguette for dunking.

meals.name: Lemony Mediterranean tuna, olive and garlic pasta
steps: Cook 1 lb pasta in well-salted water until al dente; save 1 cup pasta water.
Meanwhile warm 2 Tbsp olive oil in a large skillet over medium-low with 4 sliced garlic cloves, ½ tsp red pepper flakes and 1 tsp oregano until the garlic is golden, about 2 minutes.
Add the drained tuna (10.5 oz jar) in big flakes and ½ cup sliced olives; warm 1 minute.
Toss in the pasta with the zest and juice of 1 lemon, ¼ cup Parmesan and splashes of pasta water until glossy. Finish with chopped parsley and black pepper.
